intent: A drowned coast where the tide never went out: slate-grey shingle and black rock strewn with bleached wreck ribs and silvered driftwood, dark sea-green wrack and pale tide-pools, and one dead lighthouse burning its last amber lamp, so from the high camera it reads as pale bone ribs and green flecks across a cold grey-blue shore.
requests: A hull sculpt kind for a half-buried ship, planks and ribs and a broken deck as one form; the bones and arch kinds can only suggest it.
A sea-green phosphorescence particle texture of Brinewrack's own; the theme borrows the aurora kit's wisp and veil.
A cold moonlit sea lighting preset; the mood preset is the closest, but a colder, hazier night over the water was wanted.
